gamble.publicMechanic: After an eligible winning spin, choose red or black; the resulting amount doubles on success and becomes zero on failure. Take Win/close uses Finish. Starting the next spin uses FinishAndStart.
gamble.parameterMeaningCaution: These are raw public provider fields. DoublingMaxWin is displayed as a500 DMO limit; the fetched client does not establish whether it caps the amount before doubling, the possible result, or another eligibility check. Do not silently call it maximum gamble stake.
gamble.authoritativeEligibility: Client enables the next gamble only when Board.Options contains OptionKey Double. Receives DoubleGameStage, UserWin/TotalWin and card fields. Client code does not disclose win probability.
gamble.displayContract: Red/black buttons store the chosen color locally and send the Double event; the displayed card is selected consistently with the returned win/loss result. No server probability is inferred from this animation.
gamble.modelStatus: Pending; current draft settles immediately and exposes no gamble/collect action.
